label: bounded finite engineering hypotheses, not fundamental laws

hypotheses.statement: Down-set closure is extensive on every admitted finite fixture.
Down-set closure is monotone on every admitted finite fixture.
Down-set closure is idempotent on every admitted finite fixture.
The empty set has empty closure for the declared posets.
The intersection of any two enumerated closed sets is closed.
Distinct outside elements satisfy anti-exchange for every closed set.
Complements of closed sets are union-closed feasible sets.
Every nonempty feasible set has a removable element that leaves a feasible set.
Every closed set is the closure of its computed extreme points for these finite fixtures.
Every returned generator closes to its target and no proper subset does.
Each rooted circuit records a minimal premise forcing its declared root.
Every admitted basic word has feasible prefixes.
Deletion preserves the declared finite convex-geometry invariants.
Restriction to a declared subset preserves closure-system and anti-exchange checks.
A correction record preserves the predecessor digest while binding the replacement digest.
